response.justification: Bogdan demonstrates deep distributed systems expertise through high-throughput roles at Dunnhumby and re:cinq, strong Python/TypeScript fluency, and hands-on AI-agent infrastructure work—directly aligning with the role’s AI-native engineering mandate. His operational ownership, open-source leadership, and cross-functional collaboration history (e.g., GISCollective, CI/CD setup) fulfill non-technical requirements. Minor concerns include limited explicit LLM exposure and German language barrier in a Berlin-based team.

Deep distributed systems background with high-throughput, low-latency systems at Dunnhumby

concerns: No explicit mention of LLM or ML product experience beyond AI-agent tooling
